scope: Proposition 6.1 of the manuscript “Termination for projective log canonical fourfolds with rational boundary” (preprints/Termination-for-projective-log-canonical-fourfolds-with-rational-boundary-September-24-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 056 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 8ac06a1f5c9a11c5), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 21. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Let Y be a normal projective Q-factorial fourfold, and let (Y, Θ) be an effective terminal pair with rational boundary. Let T be an irreducible curve in Sing Y contained in a positive-coefficient component of Θ. Put j : Yreg ↪→ Y, VT = (R2 j∗Q)|T◦ , bT = dimQ H2 c (T◦ , VT ), where T◦ is a sufficiently small smooth dense open on which the indicated sheaf is a local system. There are at least bT distinct normalized divisorial valuations v of C(Y ) such that cY (v) = T, a(v; Y, 0) = 2, a(v; Y, Θ) < 2. The valuations obtained for different curves T are distinct.
